CMBS (Collision Mitigation Braking System)
The system is designed to alert the driver when the potential for a collision is determined (such as a vehicle, motorcycle, bicycle, or pedestrian in front) which will notify on the Multi-Information Display and alert sound together. In case there is no response from the driver or the vehicle is in range of collision risk, the system will assist in reducing speed automatically to avoid collisions or decrease collision severity.
